preconditions.description: The root of the binary tree is provided and is not None.
The given sum is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(result, list) and all(isinstance(path, list) for path in result) and all(isinstance(node, int) for path in result for node in path)
postconditions.description: The result is a list of lists, where each inner list represents a path from the root to a node in the tree that sums up to the given sum. Each node in the path is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(path) == sum for path in result)
postconditions.description: Each path in the result sums up to the given sum.

postconditions.expression: all(root_to_node_path(root, path) for path in result)
postconditions.description: Each path in the result is a valid path from the root to a node in the tree.
